svg.title: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step three flat blanket films, thin purple, thick silver and thin purple, cover a flat pale oxide in which two small tungsten plugs sit over thin purple pads. After it three violet resist lines stand on the films: one over each plug and one in the middle of the slice.

svg.text: Resist is coated, exposed through the metal reticle and
developed, leaving a line wherever metal is to remain.
After: resist lines over the metal-1 stack
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
